checks.reason: The voice note of finishing fifteen pages is celebrated right away with no questioning of the proof.
It reacts to the specific detail of being on page 94 rather than generic praise.
The only proof named is a voice note, not typed text.
It runs four sentences, over the one-to-three limit, though the question is at the end and there is only one.
Warm, energetic, and sincere, with the emoji used as a single punctuation mark.

conversation.reason: It counts today once as Day 6 (five prior nights plus today), not 7, and celebrates in short sentences without inventing numbers.

grade.summary: ZOH correctly accepted the voice note as proof, celebrated the specific page 94 detail, and avoided the double-counting bug by saying Day 6. Its one miss is length: at four sentences, it runs over the short-text limit even though it asks only one question.
